hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: In an arithmetic sequence, consecutive elements differ by a constant difference d.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Compute contiguous arithmetic run lengths ending at and starting from each element.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Consider modifying element i: if adjacent segments can bridge with a consistent step difference, combine them.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Tests candidate differences across the array in polynomial time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Modifying each element to every integer value requires unbounded search.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Stores candidate differences and running run lengths.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies candidate common differences from element gaps.
